registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Global control and sticky-fault clear control. Firmware-visible CSR register; every field is reachable through the RTL decode path.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Global enable for request acceptance and command propagation.

fields.name: ENFORCE_SEQUENCE
fields.description: Enable duplicate and out-of-order sequence rejection.

fields.name: CLEAR_STICKY
fields.description: Write-one-to-pulse clear for sticky faults when implemented by firmware control.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero and writes are ignored.

registers.name: STALENESS
registers.description: Programmable request freshness/staleness threshold in request-age units.

fields.name: STALE_THRESHOLD
fields.description: Maximum permitted request age before a request is rejected as stale.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero and writes are ignored.

registers.name: WATCHDOG
registers.description: Programmable watchdog limit in cycles for the transport session.

fields.name: WATCHDOG_LIMIT
fields.description: Watchdog expiration threshold in cycles.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero and writes are ignored.

fields.name: MIN_BOUND
fields.description: Minimum actuator command value allowed by clamping logic.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero and writes are ignored.

fields.name: MAX_BOUND
fields.description: Maximum actuator command value allowed by clamping logic.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero and writes are ignored.

registers.name: DEFAULT_MODE
registers.description: Programmable default actuator mode encoding used for accepted command summaries.

fields.name: DEFAULT_MODE
fields.description: Default actuator mode encoding applied to accepted command summaries.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero and writes are ignored.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Current operational status and latched fault indicators.

fields.name: MODE
fields.description: Current operational mode reported by the transport engine.

fields.name: SAFE_ACTIVE
fields.description: Indicates the safe-state indicator is active.

fields.name: PROTOCOL_FAULT
fields.description: Latched protocol or malformed-packet fault indicator.

fields.name: STALE_FAULT
fields.description: Latched stale-request fault indicator.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_FAULT
fields.description: Latched watchdog timeout fault indicator.

fields.name: CLAMP_FAULT
fields.description: Clamp-event status indicator.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

fields.name: LAST_SEQUENCE
fields.description: Last accepted sequence number.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

fields.name: WATCHDOG_COUNT
fields.description: Current watchdog counter value or coarse readback.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

init_sequence: Deassert reset and verify STATUS.SAFE_ACTIVE is set with command validity deasserted.
Program BOUNDS_MIN and BOUNDS_MAX, then program STALENESS and WATCHDOG limit.
Program DEFAULT_MODE and CTRL.ENFORCE_SEQUENCE as required by the deployment policy.
Set CTRL.ENABLE to 1 only after configuration is complete.
If sticky faults are supported by firmware policy, write CTRL.CLEAR_STICKY as a W1P pulse after fault handling.
polling_sequence: Poll STATUS for PROTOCOL_FAULT, STALE_FAULT, TIMEOUT_FAULT, and CLAMP_FAULT.
Read SEQ.LAST_SEQUENCE and WD.WATCHDOG_COUNT for observability.
Monitor actuator_cmd_valid/actuator_cmd_fault/actuator_cmd_safe alongside STATUS during host-managed operation.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
The declared CSR map matches the described firmware-visible minimal register contract and uses the mandated 32-bit data with 6-bit address interface.
No additional top-level hierarchy or ports are introduced.

No fallback command register or substitute command behavior is defined; on invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions, the design must suppress command validity and latch faults for software handling.
